newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit moves up a bit vs dlr in tepid dealings.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit moves up a bit vs dlr in tepid dealings.

text.p: The ringgit moved a few notches higher in tepid trading at the month's end and ahead of the weekend, dealers said.
"It's very boring. I want to fall asleep," said one senior dealer. Another dealer said technical charts also showed no clear direction for the currency.
The ringgit was also reflecting the dollar's muted movements against major currencies in Asia, dealers said.
At 0900 GMT, ringgit was at 2.4934/39 per dollar against 2.4936/46 at close on Thursday.
The ringgit has been trapped between 2.4920 and 2.4950 in the past week, a narrow range seen continuing in the immediate term.
In the interbank market, interest rates were firmer as bids by big banks spurred the news-hungry market.
The one-month rate was at 7.25 percent from 7.10/20 previously.
